theorem: The W33 QEC ouroboros is the stabilizer/logical feedback loop. Local vertex and triangle checks read the same 240-edge carrier that holds the 81 logical sectors. The line-star tail spans those 81 sectors modulo vertex checks; imposing it as stabilizers collapses k to zero. Therefore the correct closure is protected self-reference: preserve and protect H1=81 by the Steane/Phi6 [[82320,81,>=81]] layer, while Q4 packets remain local [[1296,81,4]] routing hardware.
